d:
Diwali Special : divali ka tyohar najdik aate hi patna ke bajar rang-birange dipon ki roshni se guljar ho gae hain. bajaron men ek se barhkar ek aakarshak diye dekhne ko mil rahe hain. paranprik mitti ke diyon se lekar dijainar aur rang-birange dip logon ko khub aakarshit kar rahe hain.
Divali ki kharidari ke lie log bajar pahunch rahe hain. dukandaron ko bhi is bar achchhe karobar ki ummid hai. aakhir is bar bajar men kis tarah ke diye logon ki pahli pasand ban rahe hain? dekhie patna ke bajar se khas riporta.
